data.name: AppName
data.comment: The editor's name, as message box titles show it.

data.name: WindowTitle
data.comment: The window's title. {0} is the open theme's folder name.

data.name: Usage
data.value: The editor opens one theme at a time. Start it as: MarqueeEditor [theme or folder]
data.comment: Shown when the editor is started with more than one argument. "MarqueeEditor" stays as it is.

data.name: RefuseElevated
data.value: The theme editor doesn't run as administrator, so the theme files it saves stay yours. Close it, and start it again normally: from the Start menu, or the tray's "Edit theme…".
data.comment: Shown when the editor is started with administrator rights; it then closes. "Edit theme…" is the tray menu's item.

data.name: ThemeNotFound
data.value: The editor couldn't find the theme to open. {0}
data.comment: Shown when the theme named on the command line or in config.yaml isn't there. {0} says where it looked.

data.name: CouldNotOpen
data.comment: {0} is the theme's folder name, {1} why it couldn't be opened, often with a line in layout.yaml.

data.name: CouldNotCopy
data.comment: When making a copy of a theme to edit. {0} is the theme's folder name, {1} the reason from Windows.

data.name: CouldNotRestore
data.value: The unsaved changes couldn't be restored: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the reason.

data.name: MakeCopyQuestion
data.value:
{0} can't be edited where it is. {1}
Yes: make a copy to edit, in your themes. No: open it read-only. Cancel: don't open it.
data.comment: Asked when opening a theme the editor can't save, such as an installed example. {0} is the theme's folder name, {1} why it can't be saved. Yes, No and Cancel are the message box's buttons.

data.name: RestoreQuestion
data.comment: Asked when a theme opens after the editor ended without closing (a crash, Task Manager). {0} is the theme's folder name; {1} and {2} are when the unsaved changes and layout.yaml were last written.

data.name: AlreadyOpen
data.value: {0} is already open in another editor window.
data.comment: Shown when the theme is open in another editor whose window couldn't be brought forward. {0} is the theme's folder name.

data.name: CloseUnsavedQuestion
data.value:
layout.yaml couldn't be saved. {0}
Close it anyway? Your changes are kept, and offered the next time you open this theme.
data.comment: Asked when the window closes, or another theme opens, while the last save failed. {0} is why, and when it is tried again.

data.name: ThemePickerTip
data.comment: The tooltip of the theme's name in the toolbar, which opens the theme picker.

data.name: NewFromExample
data.comment: The theme picker's submenu that copies an example into your themes and opens the copy.

data.name: NoExamples
data.comment: The New from an example submenu's only line when no installed examples are found.

data.name: AddWidget
data.comment: The toolbar menu listing the widget types to add.

data.name: Undo
data.comment: The toolbar's undo button, for screen readers, and its tooltip when there is nothing to undo.

data.name: Redo
data.comment: The toolbar's redo button, for screen readers, and its tooltip when there is nothing to redo.

data.name: UndoStep
data.comment: The undo button's tooltip. {0} is what undo takes back, such as "Move" or "Add gauge".

data.name: RedoStep
data.comment: The redo button's tooltip. {0} is what redo makes again.

data.name: Align
data.comment: The toolbar menu that aligns and distributes the selected widgets.

data.name: AlignLeft
data.comment: Moves the selected widgets so their left edges line up.

data.name: AlignCenter
data.comment: Moves the selected widgets so their centres line up, across.

data.name: AlignRight
data.comment: Moves the selected widgets so their right edges line up.

data.name: AlignTop
data.comment: Moves the selected widgets so their top edges line up.

data.name: AlignMiddle
data.comment: Moves the selected widgets so their middles line up, down.

data.name: AlignBottom
data.comment: Moves the selected widgets so their bottom edges line up.

data.name: DistributeHorizontally
data.comment: Spaces three or more selected widgets evenly across.

data.name: DistributeVertically
data.comment: Spaces three or more selected widgets evenly down.

data.name: ZoomFit
data.comment: Zooms the canvas to fit the window.

data.name: Zoom100
data.comment: Zooms the canvas so each theme pixel is one pixel of the screen.

data.name: Zoom200
data.comment: Zooms the canvas to twice that.

data.name: ShowOnScreen
data.comment: The toolbar button that makes the open theme the one on the screen.

data.name: ShowOnScreenTip
data.value: Make this the theme on the screen: the editor writes it into config.yaml, and the tray switches to it.
data.comment: The Show on screen button's tooltip. config.yaml stays as it is.

data.name: ShownOnScreen
data.value: config.yaml now names {0}, so the tray shows it.
data.comment: The status bar after Show on screen. {0} is the theme's folder name.

data.name: ShowOnScreenFailed
data.comment: {0} is the reason.

data.name: Saved
data.comment: The save state: layout.yaml holds every change.

data.name: Saving
data.comment: The save state: a change is about to be saved, or being saved.

data.name: NotSaved
data.comment: The save state when the last save failed; its tooltip says why.

data.name: SaveReadOnly
data.comment: The save state of a theme opened read-only, which is never saved.

data.name: SaveFailedDetail
data.comment: The tooltip of Not saved. {0} is why the save failed, {1} the time it is tried again.

data.name: NoProblems
data.comment: The toolbar's problems list when the theme has none.

data.name: OneProblem
data.comment: The toolbar's problems list with one problem.

data.name: Problems
data.comment: The toolbar's problems list with two or more. {0} is how many.

data.name: PausedBanner
data.value: Editing is paused: {0}. Fix layout.yaml, or revert to the version you opened.
data.comment: The bar over the canvas while layout.yaml doesn't load, after a hand edit. {0} is the error, with its line.

data.name: ReadOnlyBanner
data.comment: The bar over the canvas for a theme opened read-only. {0} says why it can't be saved.

data.name: RevertToOpened
data.comment: The paused bar's button: puts layout.yaml back as it was when the editor opened it, as one undo step.

data.name: MakeCopyToEdit
data.comment: The read-only bar's button: copies the theme into your themes and opens the copy.

data.name: KeepEditing
data.value: Keep editing in your text editor
data.comment: The paused bar's other button: puts the bar away, and editing stays paused until layout.yaml loads again.

data.name: SaveToFolder
data.comment: Offered under the save state when the theme's folder was moved, renamed or deleted while it was open: saves the text as layout.yaml in a folder you choose, and opens it from there.

data.name: SaveToFolderTitle
data.value: Choose a folder to save layout.yaml in
data.comment: The title of the folder picker Save to a folder… opens.

data.name: SaveToFolderFailed
data.comment: The status bar when Save to a folder… fails. {0} is the reason.

data.name: ReplaceLayoutQuestion
data.value: {0} already has a layout.yaml, another theme's perhaps. Replace it with this theme's?
data.comment: Asked by Save to a folder… when the folder chosen has a layout.yaml. {0} is the folder.

data.name: RecoveryOff
data.comment: The status bar when the editor can't keep its copy of unsaved changes for after a crash. {0} says why.

data.name: ReadOnlyRefused
data.value: This theme is read-only. Make a copy to edit it.
data.comment: The status bar when an edit is tried on a read-only theme.

data.name: PausedRefused
data.value: Editing is paused until layout.yaml loads again.
data.comment: The status bar when an edit is tried while editing is paused.

data.name: TrayNotRunning
data.comment: The status bar when Marquee's tray isn't running.

data.name: TrayNotRunningTip
data.value: Marquee's tray isn't running, so the canvas shows what the editor reads itself, and samples for the rest.
data.comment: The tooltip of Tray not running.

data.name: LayersPanel
data.comment: The heading of the layers panel.

data.name: PropertiesPanel
data.comment: The heading of the properties panel.

data.name: TestValuesPanel
data.comment: The heading of the test values panel.

data.name: ActionFailed
data.comment: The status bar when the editor refuses an action. {0} is the action, such as "Move" or "Paste"; {1} why.

data.name: ActionDrag
data.comment: An action, as ActionFailed names it: moving, resizing or turning on the canvas.

data.name: ActionSelect
data.comment: An action, as ActionFailed names it.

data.name: ActionCopy
data.comment: An action, as ActionFailed names it: copying widgets.

data.name: ActionCopyStyle
data.comment: An action, as ActionFailed names it: copying a widget's style (Ctrl+Shift+C).

data.name: ClipboardBusy
data.value: Another program is using the clipboard. Try again.
data.comment: The status bar when copying fails because the clipboard is busy.

data.name: CouldNotReadFramePixels
data.value: Could not read the frame's pixels.
data.comment: An internal error, if a frame couldn't be copied to the canvas.
